title: Airborne Rescuer R2-D2
front_description: In thc Geonosian droid factory, Padmé wrestles with one of her winged attackers and is thrown into a large, empty vat moving down the assembly line. Mechanized arms carry the vat to a position where molten metal will soon be poured into it. Desperate, the young Senator struggles to find handholds for escape, but the vat walls are sheer and unclimbable. Catching sight of Padmé's dilemma, a determined Artoo flies to her rescue.
back_description: Closer view of the digital, mini-jet propelled R2-D2.
